# Fuwad

> Fuwad is a designer from Kozhikode, Kerala, India. He founded and leads Friends of Figma Kozhikode, has used Figma since 2019, and is applying for the Design Advocate role at Figma.

## Key facts
- Founded Friends of Figma Kozhikode in June 2024. It has 3,220 members and is the #3 chapter in India and #5 globally.
- Has used Figma since 2019.
- Creates design content on Instagram (@fuwad.design, 5K+ followers).
- Teaches Figma workshops and mentors aspiring designers one-on-one.
